findings.title: Purification keeps the Highest distinct from the created cycle
findings.claim: The command to glorify makes the Highest distinct from both the flourishing and the decay of created forms.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb carries declaring the Lord free from defect, while the supplied 87:5 endpoint and exoneration parallels provide the independent created-cycle and false-attribution triggers; their contact changes praise into a boundary-making act.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the command as preserving the Lord's exaltation across the whole visible cycle, including its dark endpoint, while the ordinary call to glorify remains intact.
findings.containment: This is a bounded purification relation, not a claim that the command names every created process or that the later cycle replaces verbal glorification. The motion reading remains separately recorded, and the cited contextual parallels are evidence for the boundary rather than a spatial theology.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication gives an exact focus branch anchor and the packet supplies independent exoneration targets; legacy reader records corroborate the same bounded 87:5 change.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Glorification becomes an act that keeps the Highest from being confused with any transient created condition.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary imperative to glorify remains primary; no claim is made that every occurrence of tasbih or every created state carries this exact contextual relation.

findings.containment: The stagewise care reading is added to the ordinary addressed Lord-title; it does not erase authority, ownership, or the grammatical name phrase. The sequence is read as a contextual unpacking, not as a claim that every relative clause is grammatically contained in this ayah.

epistemic.reason: A trusted exact focus publication anchors the branch, while the packet's creation-and-guidance parallels provide independent operational triggers; the legacy synthesis is corroborative.

findings.title: Highestness sets a measure against rival elevation
findings.claim: The Most High designation can function as a measure by which human claims and preferences toward elevation are seen in relation to divine high rank.

findings.reader_payoff: The closing epithet does more than state height: it makes elevation itself a question of what is truly high and what merely claims to be.
findings.containment: The ethical comparison is an added contextual resonance, not a replacement for the divine epithet or a claim that the focus is a direct commentary on every human status. Spatial, honorable, and blameworthy highness remain distinct live facets.

epistemic.reason: The publication is trusted and gives exact focus branches, but its weak prior label and the analogical move from highness to preference require an explicit qualification.

findings.title: Later returns make the command both practice and scale
findings.claim: When the later text is supplied, the opening command is newly legible both as enacted remembrance and as a measure for choosing what counts as higher.
findings.mechanism: 87:15 returns to the sabbih-ism relation through remembrance and prayer, while 87:16-17 returns to al-A'la through the near/later contrast; the two independent returns alter the reader's view of the opening in different directions.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can experience the later context as changing the opening without choosing between its practical and evaluative effects.
findings.containment: This finding records a retrospective change, not a surah thesis or a ranking of the two readings. The ordinary imperative, name, and Most High remain recoverable, and the spatial-to-value transfer remains qualified.

epistemic.reason: The supplied retrospective report is legacy_unbound; exact later target texts independently anchor the two returns, but their combined reader effect remains an inference.

findings.title: Care as a process is held under an elevated name
findings.claim: The phrase can hold the Lord's stagewise care as a process whose named source is raised above the products of that process.
findings.mechanism: The Rabb carrier meets the ordered creation-and-guidance sequence, while the ism and al-A'la relations are independently activated by the supplied Lord-name and high-rank parallels; the contacts explain one another without merging their branches.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the title and its following creative operations can belong together: the process of care is named, and the name is held above what it forms.
findings.containment: The process reading supplements the ordinary addressed Lord-title and does not turn al-A'la into a spatial label or the name into a product. The causal claim comes from sequence and is explicitly inferential.

epistemic.reason: The wide-context reader support explicitly names both focus branches and the chained predicates, but its source is legacy_unbound and the explanatory relation is inferred from sequence.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.

branch_activations.boundary: The process is an added contextual relation; it does not replace authority or claim that all following material is a definition.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ad, adlandırma ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik
branch_activations.facet_statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.

branch_activations.activation: The naming context raises the care process above the products it governs by attaching it to an exalted source.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The process of nurture is perceived through a name that remains above what it forms.
branch_activations.boundary: The designation branch remains ordinary and relational; no claim is made that the name itself performs the care.

findings.title: Decay makes separation and motion visible together
findings.claim: The pasture-to-dark-stubble return can make the command newly perceptible as both separation from every generated state and movement through a full transformation.
findings.mechanism: 87:5 supplies the independent endpoint that corrects a flourishing-only picture, while the exact sabbih carrier retains both the purification and fluid-motion facets; 79:3 supplies a separate movement contact.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the later dark endpoint changes the opening: praise can hold the whole cycle in view, and the process can be felt as moving rather than as a static tableau.
findings.containment: The two facets coexist without becoming one winner. The purification reading remains grounded in the ordinary command; the motion reading is exploratory, has no literal medium, and retains the prior contrary/reject evidence.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective support is legacy_unbound; exact focus branches and the supplied 87:5 and 79:3 context contacts support the bounded two-facet change, while the motion facet remains qualified.

branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary praise command remains; the finding does not claim that 87:5 is grammatically part of 87:1.
